text:
We piloted an AI note-taker with our field sales team for one quarter. Here's what we learned.

**1. Reps got time back.** Post-call admin dropped by roughly 40%. Reps stopped typing in parking lots.

**2. CRM data got better.** Notes were consistent, so pipeline reviews focused on strategy, not guesswork.

**3. Consent matters.** Some buyers hesitated. Asking upfront, every time, built trust instead of eroding it.

**4. Summaries aren't insight.** The best reps still added their own read on the buyer's real concerns.

**5. Adoption followed managers.** Teams whose leads used the tool in coaching sessions stuck with it.

The takeaway: AI note-takers work best when they free reps to listen, not when they replace judgment.

What did your team learn from piloting AI tools?

*(Scenario is synthetic; figures are illustrative.)*
